title: Dinner Lady Fruit Full Lemon & Lime 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dinner Lady’s Fruit Full Lemon & Lime delivers a lively citrus blend bursting with zesty freshness. The bright, tangy sharpness of Lemon pairs effortlessly with the crisp, tart notes of Lime, creating a vibrant and refreshing vape with a bright, clean finish. Part of the Fruit Full Bar Salts collection, Lemon & Lime is crafted to capture the punchy, layered flavours often found in disposable vapes. Using a double-concentrated Nic Salt formula, this e-liquid ensures an intense, long-lasting taste while providing a smooth and satisfying vape. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid offers an excellent balance of vapour production and flavour clarity, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The nicotine salt formulation provides a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine satisfaction, making it best suited for use with pod kits and classic vape starter devices. Since 2016, Dinner Lady has been a recognised leader in e-liquid craftsmanship, offering expertly developed blends that are now enjoyed in over 80 countries worldwide. Their commitment to premium ingredients and distinctive flavour profiles continues to make them a favourite among vapers.
